source.description: Padded-length assertions for the Signal transport padding of serialized Content (Content bytes, then 0x80, then zero bytes; padded length = ceil((L+2)/80)*80 - 1). The ranges are the fixed assertions of PushTransportDetailsTest (all-zero input messages of each length in the range must pad to the given length). The boundary cases are derived directly from those ranges and the formula in spec/service/content.md section 2; they are not separate upstream vectors. The unpadding_cases are likewise illustrative, derived from the stripping rule in PushTransportDetails.java, not taken from an upstream test. Upstream has no byte-level padding vectors.
source.conventions: input_length_min/max are inclusive. padded_length is the length of the buffer handed to the session cipher. The byte at offset input_length is 0x80; all later bytes are 0x00.

unpadding_cases.note: Strip trailing 0x00 then require 0x80; content is the prefix before it.
No zero bytes after the terminator is valid.
Malformed: last non-zero byte is not 0x80; signal-service-java keeps the whole buffer unstripped.
